groups.saying_opens: كان النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم وأبو بكر
أن أباه كان يمشي أمام الجنازة

notes: Two sayings: the Prophet with Abu Bakr and Umar walking before the bier (saying 1); Ibn Umar's own practice as Salim relays it (saying 2)
The two variant groups are Tirmidhi's remarks naming other transmitters of the Zuhri version; the Ibn Umar variant ends at Salim, the father is not a link
Tirmidhi's judgement on the mursal (Yahya b. Musa, Abd al-Razzaq, Ibn al-Mubarak) is a scholars' remark, not a route; left out
